entries.title: Rest on a collapsed task's progress bar to peek at each part
entries.body: In the Tasks panel, resting the pointer on one segment of a collapsed task's progress bar opens the summary of the part that segment stands for, finished parts included. Move along the bar to check each part in turn; the rest of the row still shows the task itself.

picture.alt: A collapsed task in the Tasks panel with one segment of its progress bar taller than the rest, and that part's summary open beside the panel
